bullets.title: AMORALMAN: A True Story and Other Lies
bullets.creator: Derek DelGaudio
bullets.note: ([@derek\_del](https://twitter.com/derek_del)). From the description: “Derek DelGaudio believed he was a decent, honest man. But when irrefutable evidence to the contrary is found in an old journal, his memories are reawakened and Derek is forced to confront—and try to understand—his role in a significant act of deception from his past.” Hat tip to [Dr. Mark Plotkin](https://tim.blog/2020/09/30/mark-plotkin/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) for recommending this book to me. I’ve previously mentioned Derek in 5BF for his amazing one-man show, [_In & Of Itself_](https://www.hulu.com/movie/derek-delgaudios-in-of-itself-19b9d405-40b2-483e-8e1f-e25fe10c7299).

I only experienced the latter for the first time a few months ago with [Dave “The Snapping Turtle of Metal” Elitch](https://tim.blog/2018/11/26/dave-elitch/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf). bullets.section: Socks I used during my Antarctica trip
bullets.title: Terramar Thermasilk Over-the-Calf Sock Liner
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Terramar-Thermasilk-Liner-Black-Medium/dp/B000V5I95C/ref=sr_1_5?keywords=terramar%2Bsocks&qid=1639079555&sr=8-5&th=1), [official website](https://www.terramarsports.com/collections/mens-socks/products/sl2095)). “Over forty years ago, Terramar was the first company to introduce silk performance base layer products. Thermasilk® is still going strong. The sock liner offers a natural, super soft touch and feel with all the technology you need. The result is a breathable, lightweight layer that keeps you warm, dry, and comfortable for all your outdoor adventures.”
